title: Proof becomes a threshold
governingQuestion: When a show schedule has an evidence threshold, what exactly has—and has not—been verified?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Copenhagen turns participation into an evidence problem: admission, time, teardown, rights, screening, product data and institutional memory each demand a record. This chapter follows access: The decisive technology is not the door but the stack of schedule, accreditation, invitation and identity checks that precedes it.
beats.onScreen: Then: CPHFW introduced its framework in 2020 and has required applicants to document compliance with Minimum Standards for official schedule consideration since January 2023.
beats.credit: Scandinavian Academy of Fashion Design · CC BY-SA 4.0

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CPHFW introduced its framework in 2020 and has required applicants to document compliance with Minimum Standards for official schedule consideration since January 2023. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: For SS27, the organizer says 34 show and presentation brands were reviewed by its show committee and a Rambøll-led sustainability committee against 19 Minimum Standards.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: CPHFW states that its process validates submitted information but is not a certification scheme or audit; admission must not be restated as proof that a brand or product is sustainable.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
